text:
sara (support): Incoming from enterprise customer: multiple /v1/generate calls returning 502/504 and long tail latency. Customer provided trace ids r-0f3a2 / r-0f3a3. Happening since ~08:12 UTC. They see ~30% error rate on their requests. Can ops triage? :rotating_light:

maria (sre): looking at infra dashboards now. I see a spike in cache errors around 08:10 UTC: memcached auth failures and connection rejects on prefix pool 'pfx-prod-03'. Errors like `AUTH error: invalid` and `conn reset` followed by gateway 502s.

deploy-bot: memcached/pfx-prod-03 config reload completed 2024-11-07T08:09:52Z by ali. Change: TLS cert rotation + auth-token rollout.

jun (runtime eng): that rollout matches the timeline. If prefix cache auth fails we'll fall through to origin KV which is DB-backed and causes heavy fanout + longer inference path (more tokenization calls) — explains latency and 5xx amplification. Quick check: any recent code changes to fallback logic?

ali (platform): no code changes, only the rollout of new auth tokens. I pushed a staggered rollout but looks like pfx-prod-03 didn't receive the new token correctly (403 -> auth error). Investigating keys.

maria (sre): repro from control plane: repeated memcached auth handshake logs: ``ERROR memcached-auth: auth failed for host pfx-prod-03: invalid token`` and then ``WARN gateway: upstream unavailable, trying fallback``. Fallback attempts peaked and exhausted connection pool -> ``ERROR gateway: upstream read timeout`` -> 502 to clients.

sara (support): customer asked for mitigation now. Any temporary workaround we can offer?

jun (runtime eng): two immediate mitigations: 1) revert the token rollout on pfx-prod-03 (if we can) to restore previous auth state, or 2) enable degraded-mode routing for hosted inference (route ~10% of traffic to dedicated cached pools to reduce DB fanout). Revert is faster.

ali (platform): I can rollback the token on pfx-prod-03. Rolling back now...

deploy-bot: rollback of memcached auth token on pfx-prod-03 started by ali at 08:24:12Z.

maria (sre): after rollback I'm seeing auth successes and memcached TTL hits recover. Error rate on API dropping from 28% -> 3% over 2 minutes. Gateway 502s reduced accordingly.

sara (support): communicated to customer: temporary rollback applied, monitoring closely, asked them to confirm. They reported initial success: fewer 5xx, baseline latency back to expected.

jun (runtime eng): root cause hypothesis: token rollout script didn't verify handshake for all pfx nodes and left one node with an out-of-sync token causing auth failures. When fallback triggered, origin calls saturated downstream DB + runtime heavy path causing 502/timeout cascade.

maria (sre): immediate follow-ups: (a) run consistency check across prefix pools to ensure token parity, (b) add healthcheck that validates memcached auth success at rollout time, (c) add circuit breaker earlier to avoid exhausting gateway connection pool when all cache nodes fail.

ali (platform): I'll add a verification step to the rollout pipeline and a fast rollback hook. Also creating an incident ticket and tagging infra owners.

jun (runtime eng): for a postmortem we should capture request traces and sample payloads that hit fallback path to measure perf/regression. Suggest we log a metric for "fallback fanout rate" and alert at 5% threshold.

maria (sre): agreed. Action items: ali -> rollout pipeline change; jun -> add fallback fanout metric and circuit-breaker; ops -> run token parity sweep. I'll create the incident in PagerDuty and link the dashboards.

sara (support): closing loop with customer now. Thanks team.

--- raw snippets (copied for triage):
`Client error snippet:`
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
Request-Id: r-0f3a2
{ "error": "upstream read timeout: memcached/pfx-prod-03" }

`Gateway log excerpt:`
2024-11-07T08:10:11Z ERROR gateway: upstream read timeout id=r-0f3a2 path=/v1/generate upstream=pfx-prod-03 err="auth failed, no connections"

`Memcached auth log:`
2024-11-07T08:09:58Z ERROR memcached-auth: auth failed for pfx-prod-03 token=expired host=10.4.23.12

`Quick repro (from support sandbox):`
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"test"}' \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate

(repeat until failure; include Request-Id from response for triage)

Notes: keep this thread for postmortem summary and link incident once created.
